name: OS notification bridge
description: Mirrors KiroCrew's in-app notifications to native OS banners: approval waits, cron reports, skill reviews and the rest of the feed reach the desktop even when the dashboard is in the background. Listens to the host's own notification fan-out (channel mutes keep their meaning), enriches banners from the feed API (title, body, deep link), and adds the settings surface the platform needs: a real permission button, a background-only policy, one switch per kind, and the host's hidden turn-complete flag surfaced as a switch. Unofficial; not part of KiroCrew.
